string.text: Anastasia asked me to bring her a package with medical supplies. It doesn't matter what kind they are or where do I get them.
I've got the medical supplies. I should bring them back to Anastasia.
Anastasia asked me to procure a basic toolkit for her. It doesn't matter where I get it, but I can't bring her any other kind of tools.
I've got the tools. I should bring them back to Anastasia.
Sidorovich tasked me with delivering weather radar kits to Cold in Great Swamps.
